description: Story-focused reflective entry where other characters should become artifacts, not records.
expected_records: I spent the afternoon thinking about the scene in the novel where the brother leaves without explaining himself
I don't care whether that scene is realistic
I care that I kept defending him in my head as if he were someone I owed
I texted Lina to say the book was getting under my skin
deleted the message instead of sending it
I underlined one sentence in chapter seven
wrote "this is the part I keep living" in the margin
I still can't tell whether I miss Arun or only miss the version of myself that existed around him
